arc207_c.finding: Official solution keeps the left endpoint/current focused interval together with the previous interval OR; it then processes O(N log maxA) constant-OR start ranges with RMQ. This directly corroborates why M0 single greedy state and X1 completed-partition-only frontier were incomplete.

arc207_d.finding: Official solution splits by N/M parity and states that the game is determined only by the center area, with O(1) decision after O(NM) input. This structurally corroborates the frozen central-core minimax.

arc207_e.finding: Official solution has special N=2/impossible cases, then a general <=N+1 construction that normalizes s1!=sN and emits target characters using two ends before final cleanup. This confirms the M0 contraction-to-one-root restriction and X1 one-step correction were not complete.
